title: Leaving Humphrey for Chalamet; Humphrey's instruments
summary: He studied with Humphrey until about 1922, then took private lessons from Chalamet in the military band; Humphrey's main instrument was trumpet but he played others.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Now, I went to him, that was around, I was 19, 20. And I stayed with him until around 21, or the first part, middle part of 22 or something like that. Well then, I got in this military band and they had a man, Professor Chalamet, I heard of him. See? Well after, so I stopped taking lessons with Professor Humphrey. While being in his band, he was teaching his band. So I started taking private lessons from Chalamet.

Well, you get back because, of course, some of the Humphreys are still living, the grandchildren, and Willie is still living, the son of your professor too. But I wonder, did he ever play any instrument at your lessons? Did you know what he was best on? What he... Trumpet. Trumpet was his main instrument. Did he ever play that during your lessons? No.
He used to go around with this little club band that he had. With the club band, he played C. Clown.
Could he play any of the other instruments?
Could he play all the other instruments? He could play violin too.
Could play that. I know young Willie plays violin too, or did once. He still has a violin.
